verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS workforce platform like Deel, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out control. The available material covers the API, sandbox, webhooks, MCP server, and auth, none of which are about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
